text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents original research focused on predicting future land use and land cover change (LULCC) at the national scale of mainland Tanzania. It explicitly implements two contrasting future scenarios—Business as Usual (BAU) and Green Economy (GE)—with quantitative comparisons of LULCC outcomes (e.g., cropland expansion, woodland degradation in km²). The methodology integrates participatory stakeholder input with spatial modeling using national datasets to produce mapped, spatially explicit LULCC projections to 2025. The study covers the entire mainland territory (~883,600 km²), uses a reference LULC map, reports quantitative change rates (e.g., ~2% annual cropland expansion), and generates national-scale maps of LULCC likelihood. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
